title: Speedrun Wordle
description: Solve as many 6-letter wordles as you can in the given time limit!

title: Rainbow L
description: Editable rainbow text. This'll be sure to grab someone's attention. Go into fullscreen on a phone/laptop to use it as a neon sign thingy. I originally made this in middle school to communicate with my friend across the room during study hall since the teacher said we had to be silent. The greedy fucks over at Replit wiped my account and I lost the original, so I remade it here for nostalgia. (Can't believe I used to pay for their service only for this to happen)

title: Sparkwave
description: Little audio workstation. Doesn't really do anything useful, but it makes sound, I guess.

title: Sheep Clicker
description: Probably my first HTML game, made in 6th grade. Click the sheep for wool. That's about all there is to it.
